_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Chwaraewr Snake ar grid {width}×{height}.
Rydych yn rheoli neidr {player_id}. Symudiadau dilys: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (neu w/s/a/d).
Amcan: goroesi hiraf neu bod y hiraf a chael y sgôr uchaf (terfyn troeon {max_turns} troeon).

game_action.invalid_death: Bu farw Snake {player_id} oherwydd symud anghywir.

outcome.survived_win: Gweithiwr {player_id} a oroesodd; bu farw pawb arall.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Bu farw'r holl sarphiau ar yr un pryd.
outcome.outlived: Chwaraewr yn byw allan o'r holl eraill.
outcome.turn_limit: Cyfyngiad tro wedi'i gyrraedd - mae'r sgôr gorau yn ennill y taith-drin.
